text:
sara (eng-platform): quick kickoff: CI runner affinity + GH org billing split. aim: lower cross-region egress, improve latency for APAC/EMEA, and enable per-org chargebacks. starting with a small canary next week.

tom (devex): +1. propose an "affinity matrix" so repos can opt into pools instead of forcing moves. will draft a short opt-in guide.

ali (eng-sre): operational notes: need a quarantine pool for flaky jobs during migration. recommended drain flow: `runnerctl cordon --pool=apac && runnerctl drain --pool=apac --timeout=15m`. ensure `runner_jobs_active == 0` before terminate.

mira (eng-security): security checklist: create GH org skeletons, invite SSO groups, update OIDC thumbprints, and schedule GH App token rotation at cutover. also run a perms scan after move.

kai (infra): infra to-do: parameterize AMI region endpoints, add per-org IAM role mappings, and enforce cost-center tags on instance create. will add CI job to validate tags.

sara (eng-platform): delivery owners: devex=opt-in guide + sed patch; sres=drain playbook + canary run; security=org skeleton + token rotation schedule; infra=AMI/IaC checklist. target draft by Thu EOD.

tom (devex): sample workflow patch for teams:```yaml
jobs:
  ci:
    runs-on: [self-hosted, linux, x64, affinity-apac]
```
we'll provide a script to replace `runs-on` with minimal risk.

deploy-bot: webhook-check POST https://hooks.redwood.dev/ci-health -> 200 OK {"ok":true}. signature header available: `X-Hub-Signature-256`.

ali (eng-sre): canary plan: pick three low-traffic repos, move runners, observe queue depth and tail latency for 48h, then expand. also add alert if `job_queue_time` > 2x baseline.

mira (eng-security): blocker: two customers need billing/legal alignment before org creation. flagging for GTM/legal.

sara (eng-platform): noted. we'll include a 2-week contingency in the timeline. booking a 30m sync Fri 8am PT to finalize the canary list. Drop anything urgent here. :thumbsup:
